heading: Creators struggle to complete the character creation; users stop exploring if they aren't engaged in the interactions quickly.

blocks.html:
We collected feedbacks for our current version and consolidated the common ones in the whole product journey.

😫 Pain points for Creators:
Uncertain about the value of creating characters.
Challenges in effectively managing their created characters.
Difficult to discover the desired characters to chat with.
Don't know how to maintain a long-term emotional connection with the characters, because they are not perceiving a lot of useful feedbacks.
Unclear about the spend in the interactions.
